Embark on a poetic and enchanting journey driven by a soul-stirring, lyrical soundtrack, made by Thomas Brunet.

Chants of Sennaar es un juego de aventuras y puzles desarrollado por Rundisc y distribuido por Focus Entertainment. Ha recibido grandes elogios por parte de la crítica y el premio al Mejor Juego Independiente en los New York Game Awards 2024, además de diversas nominaciones a otros premios como los BAFTA y The Game Awards.
 
 Divididos desde el albor de los tiempos, aislados por miedo o desconfianza, los pueblos de la torre ya no se hablan. Mas cuenta la leyenda que un viajero sabrá derribar los muros y recuperar el equilibrio. Recorre los infinitos caminos de un laberinto prodigioso, averigua la verdad y desvela los misterios de este universo fascinante en el que antiguos idiomas son tanto puerta como llave.

 Descubre una enorme y enigmática torre inspirada en el mito de Babel. Encarna al viajero y sumérgete en un mundo lleno de misterios donde las gentes se han distanciado y ya no son capaces de comunicarse entre ellas. Empieza la aventura en una torre prodigiosa habitada por cinco pueblos diferentes, observa, escucha e intenta rehacer los vínculos que ha roto la desconfianza.

 Disfruta de un ingenioso sistema de juego, explora y resuelve puzles para revelar los secretos de cinco idiomas distintos pero relacionados. Con la ayuda de tu fiel cuaderno, toma nota de cada símbolo, lleva un registro del entorno, habla con la gente y desentraña el significado de los glifos. Cada paso será un peldaño en el ascenso a la torre y cada palabra un eslabón en los vínculos entre las gentes.

 Sumérgete en un lugar colorido y cautivador lleno de secretos. Lánzate a un mundo hermoso inspirado por prestigiosos autores de cómic europeos en el que cada nivel de la torre cuenta con una identidad visual propia y una tecnología, arquitectura y cultura características. Emprende un viaje apasionante y poético con una banda sonora lírica y conmovedora compuesta por Thomas Brunet.

Nommé meilleur jeu indépendant aux New York Game Awards 2024 et nominé à de nombreuses reprises lors d'autres événements (notamment The Game Awards et les BAFTA), Chants of Sennaar est un jeu d'aventure à énigmes salué par la critique. Il est développé par Rundisc.
 
 Divisés depuis la nuit des temps, isolés par la peur ou la méfiance, les Peuples de la Tour ne se parlent plus. On dit qu'un jour, un voyageur d'une grande sagesse brisera ces murs de défiance et rétablira l'équilibre. Grimpez les escaliers interminables d'un extraordinaire labyrinthe, découvrez la vérité et levez le voile sur les mystères de cet univers fascinant où les langues anciennes constituent à la fois des obstacles et des solutions. 

 Découvrez une tour aussi imposante qu'énigmatique dans ce jeu qui s'inspire du mythe de la Tour de Babel. Dans le rôle du Voyageur, plongez dans un monde de mystères où les peuples se sont éloignés les uns avec les autres, au point de ne plus pouvoir communiquer entre eux. Commencez l'aventure dans cette tour prodigieuse habitée par cinq peuplades très différentes. Observez, écoutez et faites tout votre possible pour rétablir la confiance d'autrefois.

 Avec son gameplay astucieux, le jeu vous permettra d'explorer les lieux et de résoudre diverses énigmes pour élucider les mystères de cinq langues à la fois distinctes et liées les unes aux autres. Prenez des notes sur les symboles et l'environnement dans votre fidèle carnet, engagez la conversation avec différentes personnes et découvrez la signification de tous les glyphes. À chaque pas qui vous rapprochera du sommet de la tour, les mots vous permettront de rétablir les liens entre les peuples.

 Plongez-vous dans un monde haut en couleur regorgeant de secrets. Explorez des environnements sublimes qui s'inspirent de bandes dessinées européennes, chaque étage de la tour ayant une identité visuelle, un niveau technologique, une architecture et une culture qui lui sont propres. Embarquez-vous dans un voyage poétique et enchanteur au son d'une bande originale lyrique et émouvante composée par Thomas Brunet.

Das bei den New York Game Awards 2024 als bestes Indie-Spiel ausgezeichnete und bei anderen Preisverleihungen wie The Game Awards und BAFTA mehrfach nominierte Chants of Sennaar ist ein von der Kritik hochgelobtes Rätsel- und Abenteuerspiel, das von Rundisc entwickelt wurde.
 
 Die seit Anbeginn der Zeit durch Angst und Misstrauen voneinander isolierten Völker des Turms kommunizieren nicht mehr miteinander. Es heißt, dass eines Tages ein Reisender die Weisheit finden wird, die Mauern niederzureißen und das Gleichgewicht wiederherzustellen. Erklimme die endlosen Stufen eines gewaltigen Labyrinths, entdecke die Wahrheit und lüfte die Geheimnisse dieses faszinierenden Universums, in dem die uralten Sprachen Schlüssel und Schloss zugleich sind.

 Erkunde einen gewaltigen vom Mythos von Babel inspirierten Turm voller Rätsel. Als Reisender tauchst du in eine geheimnisvolle Welt ein, in der sich die Völker immer weiter voneinander entfernt haben und nicht mehr in der Lage sind, sich zu verständigen. Beginne dein Abenteuer in einem riesigen Turm, der von fünf verschiedenen Völkern bewohnt wird. Beobachte, lausche und versuche, die vom Misstrauen zerrissenen Bande wiederherzustellen.

 Erkunde den Turm und löse unterschiedliche Rätsel mithilfe eines intelligenten Spielsystems, um die Geheimnisse fünf miteinander verbundener Sprachen zu lüften. Dein treuer Begleiter ist dabei das Notizbuch, in dem du jedes gefundene Symbol notierst. Behalte deine Umgebung im Auge, unterhalte dich mit den Bewohnern und entziffere die Bedeutung aller Glyphen. Mit jedem entschlüsselten Wort stellst du die Verbindung zwischen den Völkern wieder her und kommst der Spitze des Turms ein Stück näher.

 Eine mitreißende, farbenfrohe Welt voller Geheimnisse und Rätsel erwartet dich. Stürze dich kopfüber in eine wunderschöne Spielumgebung, die sich an einflussreichen europäischen Comics orientiert. Jede Ebene des Turms besitzt ihre eigene visuelle Identität, die sich in Form einzigartiger Technologien, Architektur und Kultur äußert. Begib dich auf ein zauberhaftes Abenteuer, das mit einem gefühlvollen lyrischen Soundtrack von Thomas Brunet unterlegt ist.

Vincitore del premio Best Indie Game ai New York Game Awards del 2024 e plurinominato in altre premiazioni tra cui The Game Awards e i BAFTA, Chants of Sennaar è un gioco di avventura e rompicapi acclamato dalla critica, sviluppato da Rundisc.
 
 Separati fin dall'alba del tempo, i Popoli della Torre non comunicano più gli uni con gli altri, isolati dalla paura o dalla sfiducia. Si dice che un giorno verrà un Viaggiatore, e la sua saggezza abbatterà le barriere e ristabilirà l'equilibrio. Viaggia per le scalinate interminabili di un prodigioso labirinto, scopri la verità e svela i misteri di questo universo affascinante in cui le lingue antiche sono insieme chiave e serratura. 

 Scopri una torre enigmatica e vasta, ispirata al mito di Babele. Nei panni del Viaggiatore, esplora un mondo pieno di misteri, dove i Popoli si sono allontanati, ormai incapaci di comunicare tra loro. Inizia la tua avventura in una torre prodigiosa abitata da cinque diversi Popoli: osserva, ascolta e fai ogni sforzo per rinsaldare i legami spezzati dalla sfiducia.

 Grazie al sistema di gameplay intelligente, esplora e risolvi diversi enigmi per scoprire i misteri di cinque diverse lingue interconnesse tra loro. Sotto la guida costante del tuo fedele diario, annota ogni simbolo, tieni traccia dell'ambiente circostante, conversa con le persone e svela il significato di ciascun glifo. Ogni passo in avanti ti porterà verso la vetta della Torre, e ogni parola rinsalderà i legami tra i Popoli.

 Immergiti in un mondo appassionante e pittoresco, colmo di segreti. Tuffati in un mondo magnifico ispirato ai maestri del fumetto europeo dove ciascun piano della Torre ha una sua identità visiva, con tecnologie, architetture e culture ben distinte. Parti per un viaggio poetico e ammaliante accompagnato da una colonna sonora che risuona in fondo all'anima, realizzata da Thomas Brunet.

game.brief:
Winner of Best Indie Game at the 2024 New York Game Awards and nominated multiple times at other ceremonies including The Game Awards and the BAFTA, Chants of Sennaar is a critically-acclaimed puzzle and adventure game developed by Rundisc.
 
 Divided since the dawn of time, the Peoples of the Tower no longer speak to each other, isolated by fear or mistrust. It is said that one day, a Traveler will find the wisdom to break down the walls and restore the balance. Travel the endless steps of a prodigious labyrinth, uncover the truth and unveil the mysteries of this fascinating universe where ancient languages are both the lock and the key.

 Inspired by the myth of Babel, discover an enigmatic and vast tower. As the Traveler, delve into a world full of mysteries, where Peoples have grown distant, unable to communicate with each other anymore. Begin your adventure in a prodigious tower inhabited by five distinct Peoples, observe, listen, and strive to mend the bonds of distrust. 
  
 With a smart gameplay system, explore and solve various puzzles to uncover the mysteries of five different interconnected languages. Always guided by your trusty notebook, note each symbol, keep track of your surroundings, engage in conversations with people and unravel the meaning of every glyph. Each step will pave your way to the top of the Tower as each word will restore the link between People.
  
 Dive into an enthralling and colorful world full of secrets. Tumble headlong into a beautiful world inspired by impactful European comics authors where every floor of the Tower possesses its own visual identity, supported by distinctive technological levels, architecture and culture. Embark on a poetic and enchanting journey driven by a soul-stirring, lyrical soundtrack, made by Thomas Brunet.

game.title: Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II
game.description:
The Star Wars Saga continues with Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II, the highly anticipated sequel to the fastest-selling Star Wars game ever created, which has sold more than seven million copies worldwide.

In Star Wars: The Force Unleashed, the world was introduced to Darth Vader’s now fugitive apprentice, Starkiller — the unlikely hero who would ignite the flames of rebellion in a galaxy so desperately in need of a champion. In the sequel, Starkiller returns with over-the-top Force powers and embarks on a journey to discover his own identity and to reunite with his one true love, Juno Eclipse.

In Star Wars: The Force Unleashed II, Starkiller is once again the pawn of Darth Vader — but instead of training his protégée as a ruthless assassin, the dark lord is attempting to clone his former apprentice in an attempt to create the Ultimate Sith warrior. The chase is on — Starkiller is in pursuit of Juno and Darth Vader is hunting for Starkiller.

With all-new devastating Force powers and the ability to dual-wield lightsabers, Starkiller cuts a swath through deadly new enemies across exciting worlds from the Star Wars movies — all in his desperate search for answers to his past.

A clone of Starkiller is created by Darth Vader. But after he escapes his master's grasp, he travels across the galaxy to discover who, or what, he really is.

game.title: Mario vs. Donkey Kong
game.description:
A remake of the first game in the Mario vs. Donkey Kong series, originally released for the Game Boy Advance. In this puzzle-platformer, the player controls Mario in a quest to recover the Mini Marios kidnapped by his eternal rival, Donkey Kong.

Run, jump, and backflip your way to rescuing the stolen Mini-Mario toys in this puzzling twist on Mario action. Obstacles like spikes, moving platforms, and falling bricks stand in your way—put your brain to work and figure out the best way to reach the Mini-Marios.

game.title: Half Step Princess
game.description:
toxic teenage lesbian romance in XXXXXXX, ontario, with swords

A  half step  is an action where the fencer makes a partial advance or retreat moving just one foot forward or back. It's an essential bit of footwork, useful to make a feint, or extend and delay one's preparation before an attack.

  ✤ ⚔︎ ✤

   It's 2011 in Ontario. We're all growing up. The future is bright. The  sun is going down. Girls take the bus home. Blades are drawn.

  Gwendolyn Baker ,   grade ten, is the new student in her fencing club. Shy and petite, an only child, she's never been very talented at sports, and she finds herself lost and frozen in the shadow of a city which seems to be fading away.

 Despite her anxieties, delinquent  Charlotte  (club ace and her upperclassman),  Joanna  (standoffish private school princess), and  Hannah Abigail  (know-it-all beauty) all set eyes on her. A haze of suburban angst and foiled romances hangs over the autumn landscape while Gwen falls into a canopy of bitter rivalries.

 ✿ ♕ ✿

 ~30k words of toxic teenage yuri, 3 months of autumn, 5 bouts, 4 closeted lesbians, 2 tournament arcs. 

  ✤ ☁ ✤

 Inspired by 60s-70s sports anime, Ontario gothic, 80s-90s shoujo,  English modernism, and 00s-10s digital nostalgia, with a dreamy original  soundtrack by   In Love With a Ghost   and art by   Madeline Miyun

  
 ✾ ♛ ✾

 Written, drawn, and composed in six weeks for   Toxic Yuri VN Jam 2

 ✤ ✝ ✤

   Historical Notes

  More than two-thirds of the population of Canada lives in the suburbs.

  From 2005 to 2009, tens of thousands of jobs were cut in the automotive industry in Ontario.

  In 2004, the City of Kitchener announced a strategic Economic Development Investment Fund to "modernize the city's business community."

  Since 1957, the University of Waterloo cooperative education program has grown to become one of the largest co-op programs in the world, with over 20,000 students enrolled today. An enormous number of those students are in the School of Computer Science.

  My bus ride home from school in Kitchenener-Waterloo took me around two hours, one way. As of 2019, KW's ION Light Rail now runs (part of) that route. I still haven't rode it.

  About a third of my high school graduating class went onto study CS. Or Engineering. Or Business, at Laurier.

  Since a dip in 1996, the average price of a home in the Greater Toronto Area has increased from around $200k to nearly $1.2m (Canadian dollars, of course).

  A study by Statistics Canada in 2026 found the Kitchener-Waterloo-Cambridge tri-city to have one of the highest unemployment rates. Small cities across Ontario have been reported as some of the worst places for job seekers in various articles and job studies over the last decade.

  The Ontario Fencing Association did not release a policy clarifying rules regarding transgender athletes until 2019.

  This story is not set in Kitchener.

  There should be no requirement for an athlete to disclose their transgender identity or history to compete in high performance sport (up to the point where international federation rules would take effect)  unless there is a justified reason to do so.

game.title: Catherine
game.description:
Vincent is trapped in a nightmare, facing a choice of marrying his longtime girlfriend Katherine or moving on to the incredible blonde he just woke up to-- named Catherine! The worst part is, if he makes the wrong choice, he could end up dead.
Hangout, drink, send texts, and watch the story unfold through full HD cinematics.

The story follows Vincent Brooks, a man who is beset by supernatural nightmares while torn between his feelings for his longtime girlfriend Katherine and the similarly named beauty Catherine. The gameplay is divided between the daytime, where Vincent interacts with the characters in a social simulation, and his dreams where he must navigate three-dimensional towers through combined platforming and puzzle-solving. The game's ending is affected by choices made by Vincent over the course of the story.

game.title: Pokémon Blue Version
game.description:
Pokémon Blue is the third core series Pokémon game released as a minor revision of Pokémon Red and Green, which were released earlier that year. It was thus the first solitary version in the core series of Pokémon games. Various fixes in the game include a graphics and sound upgrade, as well as the removal of several known glitches that had been found in the original pair. Outside of Japan, its graphics, game engine and script formed the basis of Pokémon Red and Blue, while the wild Pokémon and game-exclusive Pokémon lists were changed to match Red and Green.

The player character starts out in Pallet Town. When the player character tries to leave the town without a Pokémon of their own, they are stopped in the nick of time by Professor Oak, who invites them to his lab. There, he gives them a Pokémon of their own and a Pokédex, telling them about his dream to make a complete guide on every Pokémon in the world. After the player character battles their rival and leaves the lab, they are entitled to win every Gym Badge, compete in the Pokémon League, and fulfill Oak's dream by catching every Pokémon.

game.title: The Roottrees Are Dead
game.description: A genealogical mystery straight out of 1998. Scour the early Internet for clues, uncover hidden connections, and piece together the family tree behind the secretive Roottree Corporation.

localized_description.text: A genealogical mystery straight out of 1998. Scour the early Internet for clues, uncover hidden connections, and piece together the family tree behind the secretive Roottree Corporation.

The year is 1998. A private jet belonging to the Roottree Corporation has crashed. On it were the Roottree Sisters and their parents. Combined, they were worth over a billion dollars. 
  Now, due to the eccentricities of their great-great-grandfather Elias, their money must be redistributed to the rest of the family. But who's actually a BLOOD RELATIVE? That's where you come in. 
  Armed only with the power of your mighty dial-up modem, you'll scour for photos, books, articles and other evidence. Then, you'll make connections and deductions based on the family relationships you uncover. With every spot on the tree you fill in correctly, the names and photos left in your possession will have fewer and fewer places to go — but the evidence will also be harder and more obscure to find. 
  Can you put together the final pieces of the puzzle? 
   The Acclaimed Armchair Detective Game, Re-imagined on Steam 
  
  The Roottrees are Dead was originally created for the Global Game Jam 2023 and released as a free browser game. It was beloved by many for its clever puzzles, retro computing interface and novel world-building. The Steam version is the same great game, but enhanced in many ways: 
    Hand-drawn illustrations from acclaimed board game artist Henning Ludvigsen.
    A 3D living-room perspective that ties together all the unique puzzle systems 
    An enhanced user interface with many quality of life improvements to make your mystery solving easier to use and more intuitive 
    Remastered music and sound effects, with fully voiced cinematics.
    A handful of Easter eggs and little touches for those who can't get enough of the late ‘90s charm
    
   Includes "Roottreemania", a brand new mystery 
    Find out what happens to the Roottree family following the events of the base game.
    A whole new family tree to complete!
    Discover the scandals, lies, and infidelities that took place behind the scenes of America's largest maple candy empire.

Año 1998. Un jet privado de la Corporación Roottree acaba de estrellarse. En él, viajaban las Hermanas Roottrees y sus padres. Entre ellos, manejaban una fortuna de más de mil millones de dólares.
  
  Debido a las excentricidades de su tatarabuelo Elias, ahora el dinero debe ser distribuído entre el resto de la familia. Pero, ¿quién es realmente un PARIENTE DE SANGRE? Ahí entras tú.
  
  Con tu conexión dial-up a internet como única herramienta, deberás rastrear fotos, libros, artículos y más evidencia. Así podrás hacer deducciones sobre las relaciones familiares que descubras. Mientras más ramas del árbol genealógico llenes, los nombres y fotos serán más fáciles de colocar.. pero la evidencia será más dificil de encontrar.
  
   ¿Puedes encontrar las piezas finales del rompecabezas? 
  
  El aclamado juego para detectives aficionados, ahora reimaginado para Steam
  
  The Roottrees are Dead fue originalmente creado para la Global Game Jam 2023 y lanzado como un juego gratis de navegador. Fue apreciado por sus astutos puzles, interfaz nostálgica, y la forma novedosa en la que constuía su mundo. La versión de Steam es el mismo gran juego, pero con varias mejoras:
  
  ● Ilustraciones del conocido artista de juegos de mesa, Henning Ludvigsen.
  ● Un cuarto en 3D que conecta todos los sistemas de puzles.
  ● Una interfaz optimizada, más fácil e intuitiva para que nada se interponga en tu investigación.
  ● Música remasterizada y efectos de sonido, con escenas que incluyen actuación de voz.
  ● Varios secretos y detalles para quienes adoran la estética de los 90.
  
   Incluye "Roottreemanía", un nuevo misterio. 
  
  ● Descubre qué sucede con la familia Roottree después de la historia del juego original.
  ● ¡Hay una nueva familia que completar!
  ● Descubre los escándalos, mentiras, e infidelidades que sucedieron detrás de escena en el imperio de caramelos de arce mas grande de Estados Unidos.

Nous sommes en 1998. Un jet privé appartenant à la Roottree Corporation s'est écrasé. À son bord se trouvaient les Sœurs Roottree et leurs parents. Leur fortune cumulée dépassait le milliard de dollars.
  
  Désormais, à cause des excentricités de leur arrière-arrière-grand-père Elias, leur argent doit être redistribué au reste de la famille. Mais qui est réellement un MEMBRE DE SANG ? C'est là que vous intervenez.
  
  Uniquement armé de la puissance de votre vaillant modem 56k, vous fouillerez à la recherche de photos, de livres, d'articles et d'autres preuves. Vous devrez ensuite faire des connexions et des déductions à partir des liens familiaux découverts. À mesure que vous remplirez correctement l'arbre généalogique, il restera de moins en moins d'options possibles pour les noms et photos en votre possession... mais les preuves seront aussi plus difficiles et plus obscures à trouver.
  
  Saurez-vous assembler les dernières pièces du puzzle ?
  
   Le célèbre jeu de détective de salon, réimaginé sur Steam 
  
  The Roottrees are Dead a été créé à l'origine pour la Global Jam 2023 et publié en tant que jeu de navigateur gratuit. De nombreux joueurs l'ont adoré pour ses énigmes astucieuses, son interface informatique rétro et son univers original. La version Steam reprend le même excellent jeu, mais avec de nombreuses améliorations :
  
    Des illustrations dessinées à la main par le célèbre artiste de jeux de société Henning Ludvigsen.
    Un salon 3D immersif permettant d'accéder à tous les différents systèmes d'énigmes.
    Une interface utilisateur améliorée avec de nombreuses améliorations de qualité de vie, pour rendre votre enquête plus fluide et intuitive.
    Musique et effets sonores remasterisés, avec des cinématiques entièrement doublées.
    Plein de clins d'œil et d'easter eggs pour les amoureux de la fin des années 90.
    
     Inclut "Roottreemania", une toute nouvelle énigme 
  
    Découvrez ce qui arrive à la famille Roottree après les événements du jeu de base.
    Un tout nouvel arbre généalogique à compléter !
    Découvrez les scandales, les mensonges et les infidélités qui ont eu lieu dans les coulisses du plus grand empire de bonbons à l'érable d'Amérique.

Wir schreiben das Jahr 1998. Ein Privatjet der Roottree Corporation ist abgestürzt. Die Roottree-Sisters waren zusammen mit ihren Eltern an Bord. Zusammen hatten sie ein Vermögen von über einer Milliarde US-Dollar.
  
  Nach dem Vermächtnis ihres exzentrischen Ururgroßvaters Elias muss dieses Vermögen nun auf den Rest der Familie verteilt werden. Doch wer ist wirklich mit den Roottrees BLUTSVERWANDT? Genau da kommst du ins Spiel.
  
  Nur mit deinem mächtigen Telefonmodem bewaffnet musst du nach Fotos, Büchern, Artikeln und anderen Beweisen suchen. So kannst du je nach den Verwandtschaftsverhältnissen, die du nach und nach aufdeckst, neue Beziehungen und Schlussfolgerungen ableiten. Mit jedem Feld am Stammbaum, das du richtig ausfüllst, bleiben immer weniger freie Felder für die noch verbliebenen Namen und Fotos übrig – doch dafür sind Beweise immer schwerer zu finden.
  
  Kannst du die letzten Teile des Puzzles zusammensetzen?
  
   Das berühmte Detektivspiel für zu Hause, jetzt neu interpretiert für Steam 
  
  "The Roottrees are Dead" wurde ursprünglich für den "Global Game Jam 2023" entwickelt und als kostenloses Browser-Spiel veröffentlicht. Viele Gamer liebten es wegen der cleveren Rätsel, dem Retro-Computer-Interface und dem innovativen Entdecken einer kompletten Welt. Die Steam-Version ist das gleiche tolle Spiel, nur in vielerlei Hinsicht jetzt noch besser:
  
    Handgezeichnete Illustrationen des renommierten Brettspielgrafikers Henning Ludvigsen.
    Eine 3-D-Perspektive deines Wohnzimmers, in dem du alle Elemente des einzigartigen Rätselsystems auf einen Blick siehst.
    Ein erweitertes Benutzer-Interface mit vielen Verbesserungen, die dir das Knobeln erleichtern und die Bedienung noch intuitiver machen.
    Remasterte Musik und Sound-Effekte mit komplett gesprochenen Zwischensequenzen.
    Eine Handvoll Easter Eggs und kleiner Details für alle, die von dem Charme der späten 90er einfach nicht genug kriegen können.
    
     Inklusive "Roottreemania", einer brandneuen Knobelei 
  
    Finde heraus, was nach den Ereignissen des Hauptspiels aus der Familie Roottree geworden ist.
    Ein komplett neuer Stammbaum wartet darauf, von dir vervollständigt zu werden!
    Entdecke die Skandale, Lügen und Seitensprünge hinter den Kulissen des größten Süßigkeiten-Imperiums der USA.

The year is 1998. A private jet belonging to the Roottree Corporation has crashed. On it were the Roottree Sisters and their parents. Combined, they were worth over a billion dollars. 
  Now, due to the eccentricities of their great-great-grandfather Elias, their money must be redistributed to the rest of the family. But who's actually a BLOOD RELATIVE? That's where you come in. 
  Armed only with the power of your mighty dial-up modem, you'll scour for photos, books, articles and other evidence. Then, you'll make connections and deductions based on the family relationships you uncover. With every spot on the tree you fill in correctly, the names and photos left in your possession will have fewer and fewer places to go — but the evidence will also be harder and more obscure to find. 
  Can you put together the final pieces of the puzzle? 
   The Acclaimed Armchair Detective Game, Re-imagined on Steam 
  
  The Roottrees are Dead was originally created for the Global Game Jam 2023 and released as a free browser game. It was beloved by many for its clever puzzles, retro computing interface and novel world-building. The Steam version is the same great game, but enhanced in many ways: 
    Hand-drawn illustrations from acclaimed board game artist Henning Ludvigsen.
    A 3D living-room perspective that ties together all the unique puzzle systems 
    An enhanced user interface with many quality of life improvements to make your mystery solving easier to use and more intuitive 
    Remastered music and sound effects, with fully voiced cinematics.
    A handful of Easter eggs and little touches for those who can't get enough of the late ‘90s charm
    
   Includes "Roottreemania", a brand new mystery 
    Find out what happens to the Roottree family following the events of the base game.
    A whole new family tree to complete!
    Discover the scandals, lies, and infidelities that took place behind the scenes of America's largest maple candy empire.

game.title: Commandos: Behind Enemy Lines
game.description: Engage in the ultimate battle of wits and wills with the most ruthless military force in history. Set in the backdrop of WWII, Commandos is a real-time tactical wargame that puts you in command of a squad of elite Allied Commandos whose job is to complete 24 dangerous missions behind enemy lines. Your goal is to thwart the German war effort by means of sabotage and tactical genius.This action-packed strategy war game is set apart by its revolutionary AI, and the ability to control 6 individual commandos, each with a specific skill, as they infiltrate hostile territories and engage in intense combat. Your perilous missions will take you from the parched desert of North Africa to banks of the Rhine, the mountainous fjords of Norway, and the beaches of Normandy.Experience the most realistic, visually stunning graphics with accurate 3D models of more than 350 structures, vehicles, and weapons from the WWII era.

  About the Game FINAL FANTASY VII REMAKE is a bold reimagining of the original FINAL FANTASY VII, originally released in 1997, developed under the guidance of the original key developers.
 This critically-acclaimed game, which mixes traditional command-based combat and real-time action, makes its Steam debut along with FF7R EPISODE INTERmission─a new story arc featuring Yuffie Kisaragi.
 
    
 
 ■STORY
 
 By exploiting mako, the life-blood of the planet, through their mako reactors, the Shinra Electric Power Company has all but seized control of the entire world. A ragtag group of idealists, known as Avalanche, are one of the last bastions of resistance.
 
 Cloud, an elite SOLDIER operative-turned-mercenary takes part in an Avalanche operation to destroy Mako Reactor 1 in the city of Midgar. 
 The bombing plunges the city into fiery chaos, and Cloud is tormented by visions of a bitter enemy long thought dead. 
 
 Once more begins a story that will shape the destiny of an entire world.
 
 * This game is a remake of FINAL FANTASY VII, first released in 1997.
 The first title in a multi-part series, it is based on the story from the original game, up to the escape from Midgar, adding in new elements.
 
    
 
 ■FF7R EPISODE INTERmission (New episode featuring Yuffie Kisaragi)
 
 FF7R EPISODE INTERmission is a brand-new adventure in the world of FINAL FANTASY VII REMAKE INTERGRADE. Play as Wutaian ninja Yuffie Kisaragi as she infiltrates Midgar and conspires with Avalanche HQ to steal the ultimate materia from the Shinra Electric Power Company.
 
    
 
 ■Content included in this product
 
 FINAL FANTASY VII REMAKE INTERGRADE contains the following content:
 - FINAL FANTASY VII REMAKE full game
 - DLC "FF7R EPISODE INTERmission" (New episode featuring Yuffie Kisaragi)
 - Weapon: Cacstar
 - Armor: Midgar Bangle
 - Armor: Shinra Bangle
 - Armor: Corneo Armlet
 - Accessory: Superstar Belt
 - Accessory: Mako Crystal
 - Accessory: Seraphic Earrings
 - Summon materia: Carbuncle
 - Summon materia: Chocobo Chick
 - Summon materia: Cactuar
 
 *The additional weapons, armor, accessories and summon materia can be obtained from the Gift Box on the main menu.
 *The weapon "Cacstar" can only be used in FF7R EPISODE INTERmission (Yuffie episode)

  关于游戏 《FINAL FANTASY VII REMAKE》由1997年上市的《FINAL FANTASY VII》主要原班人马精心打造。
 因跌宕起伏的剧情与充满魅力的角色，以及运用当时最先进技术制作的画面，而深受众多玩家喜爱的不朽名作，如今将重生为“全新故事”。
 指令式战斗融合操作直觉的动作系统，衍生出更丰富的战略性，并运用现代CG技术重现身临其境般的《FINAL FANTASY VII》世界。
 
    
 
 ■STORY
 
 抽取自星球的生命能源──魔晄。
 在“米德加”这个拥有八座魔晄炉的阶层都市，
 凭借魔晄掌握世界的巨型企业“神罗公司”与为了保护星球挺身而出的反神罗组织“雪崩”爆发激烈冲突。
 前神罗战士克劳德，以佣兵的身份参加雪崩的“壹号魔晄炉引爆作战”。
 魔晄炉爆炸的巨响响彻第捌区。
 陷入火海的城镇中，出现那位已故死敌飘渺的幻影。
 克劳德追着渴望消除的昔日幻影，最后与她相遇。
 卖花女递出一朵黄花，
 花语是“重逢”。
 刹那间，一团黑影──“命运守望者”将两人包围。
 现在，心念将再次于星球流转。
 
 ※本作为1997年上市的《FINAL FANTASY VII》之重制版。
 以原作中直到逃离米德加的剧情为基础，加入全新原创内容，是预计推出多部系列作的首部作品。
 
    
 
 ■“FF7R EPISODE INTERmission”（尤菲的新篇章）
 
 “FF7R EPISODE INTERmission”（尤菲的新篇章）是新角色“尤菲”的故事。
 潜入米德加的五台忍者们将与雪崩总会共同策画，挑战从神罗公司盗出究极魔晶石的任务。
 ※“FF7R EPISODE INTERmission”（尤菲的新篇章）中，能够操作“尤菲”作为游玩角色。

 ・《FINAL FANTASY VII REMAKE》游戏本篇

  關於此遊戲 《FINAL FANTASY VII REMAKE》由1997年上市的《FINAL FANTASY VII》主要原班人馬精心打造。
 因為壯大的劇情與充滿魅力的角色，以及運用當時最先進技術製作的畫面，而深受眾多玩家喜愛的不朽名作，如今將重生為「全新故事」。
 指令式戰鬥融合操作直覺的動作系統，衍生出更豐富的戰略性，並運用現代CG技術重現身歷其境的《FINAL FANTASY VII》世界。
 
    
 
 ■STORY
 
 抽取自星球的生命能源──「魔晄」。
 在「米德加」這個擁有八座魔晄爐的階層都市，
 藉由魔晄掌握世界的巨大企業「神羅公司」與為了保護星球挺身而出的反神羅組織「雪崩」爆發激烈衝突。
 前神羅戰士克勞德，以傭兵的身份參加雪崩的「壹號魔晄爐引爆作戰」。
 魔晄爐爆炸的巨響響徹第捌區。
 陷入火海的城鎮中，出現那位已故死敵飄渺的幻影。
 克勞德追著渴望消滅的昔日幻影，最後與她相遇。
 賣花女遞出一朵黃花，
 花語是「重逢」。
 這瞬間，一團黑影──「命運守望者」將兩人包圍。
 現在，心念將再次於星球流轉。
 
 ※本作為1997年上市的《FINAL FANTASY VII》之重製版。
 以原作直到逃離米德加的劇情為基礎，再加入全新原創內容，是預計推出多部系列作的首部作品。

 This critically-acclaimed game, which mixes traditional command-based combat and real-time action, makes its Steam debut along with FF7R EPISODE INTERmission─a new story arc featuring Yuffie Kisaragi.
 
    
 
 ■STORY
 
 By exploiting mako, the life-blood of the planet, through their mako reactors, the Shinra Electric Power Company has all but seized control of the entire world. A ragtag group of idealists, known as Avalanche, are one of the last bastions of resistance.
 
 Cloud, an elite SOLDIER operative-turned-mercenary takes part in an Avalanche operation to destroy Mako Reactor 1 in the city of Midgar. 
 The bombing plunges the city into fiery chaos, and Cloud is tormented by visions of a bitter enemy long thought dead. 
 
 Once more begins a story that will shape the destiny of an entire world.
 
 * This game is a remake of FINAL FANTASY VII, first released in 1997.
 The first title in a multi-part series, it is based on the story from the original game, up to the escape from Midgar, adding in new elements.

  Acerca del juego FINAL FANTASY VII REMAKE es una atrevida reconstrucción del videojuego FINAL FANTASY VII, que fue lanzado en 1997, y se ha desarrollado obedeciendo a la visión de los desarrolladores principales del original.
 Este juego aclamado por la crítica combina el combate tradicional por turnos con la acción en tiempo real, y se ofrece ahora por primera vez en Steam junto con FF7R EPISODE INTERmission, una nueva historia con Yuffie Kisaragi como protagonista. 
 
    
 
 HISTORIA
 
 Mediante sus reactores succionadores de mako, la savia del planeta, la Compañía de Electricidad y Energía Shinra prácticamente se ha apoderado del mundo. Solo un grupo de idealistas conocido como Avalancha opone resistencia a su dominio.
 
 Cloud, un Soldado de élite convertido en mercenario, participa en una operación de Avalancha cuyo fin es la destrucción del reactor de mako n.º 1 de Midgar. 
 La explosión convierte la ciudad en un infierno, y Cloud sufre alucinaciones de su archienemigo, a quien creía muerto. 
 
 Así comienza, una vez más, la historia que definirá el destino de todo un mundo. 
 
 * Este juego es un remake de FINAL FANTASY VII, lanzado a la venta por primera vez en 1997.
 Es el primer título de una serie de juegos basados en la historia del juego original, y comprende los eventos hasta la huida de Midgar, incluyéndose además elementos adicionales.

  À propos du jeu FINAL FANTASY VII REMAKE est une réinterprétation en plusieurs volets de FINAL FANTASY VII, initialement sorti en 1997. Il a été conçu sous la direction des principaux membres de l'équipe originale.
 Ce jeu à grand succès, dont les combats mêlent action et commandes classiques, arrive sur Steam accompagné de FF7R EPISODE INTERmission, un épisode bonus consacré à Yuffie Kisaragi.
 
    
 
 ■ SYNOPSIS
 
 Le monde est contrôlé par la compagnie Shinra qui exploite la mako, l'énergie vitale de la planète. Dans la mégalopole de Midgar, un groupe de hors-la-loi idéalistes connu sous le nom d'Avalanche consistue l'un des derniers bastions de la résistance.
 
 Cloud, un ex-membre des troupes d'élite de la Shinra, accompagne Avalanche lors d'une opération de destruction du réacteur mako nº 1. L'explosion plonge la ville dans un brasier chaotique et Cloud est tourmenté par des visions d'un ennemi qu'il pensait mort depuis longtemps.
 
 Embarquez dans une grande aventure qui décidera du sort de la planète !
 
 * Ce jeu est une réinterprétation en plusieurs volets de FINAL FANTASY VII, initialement sorti en 1997.
 L'histoire de ce premier volet retrace la fuite des héros hors de Midgar et nous fait vivre les événements qui secouent la ville avec une profondeur nouvelle.
 
    
 
 ■ FF7R EPISODE INTERmission (Épisode de Yuffie)
 
 Cet épisode est constitué de deux chapitres séparés de l'histoire principale de FINAL FANTASY VII REMAKE. Jouez Yuffie, une shinobi du Wutai qui s'infiltre à Midgar avec son partenaire grâce à l'aide de la branche principale d'Avalanche afin de dérober une matéria ultime créée par la Shinra.

  Acerca do jogo O FINAL FANTASY VII REMAKE é uma ousada recriação do FINAL FANTASY VII original, lançado em 1997, e conta com a orientação dos principais produtores do jogo original.
 Este jogo aclamado pela crítica, que mistura o combate tradicional baseado em comandos com ação em tempo real, faz a sua estreia no Steam juntamente com FF7R EPISODE INTERmission, um novo arco de história protagonizado por Yuffie Kisaragi.
 
    
 
 ■HISTÓRIA
 
 Graças à exploração do mako, a energia vital do planeta, através dos seus reatores mako, a Shinra Electric Power Company assumiu o controlo dos destinos do mundo. Um grupo desorganizado de idealistas, conhecido como Avalanche, é um dos últimos focos de resistência.
 
 Cloud, um ex-operacional SOLDIER de elite e agora mercenário, participa numa operação da Avalanche para destruir o Reator Mako 1 em Midgar. 
 O ataque lança a cidade no caos e Cloud é atormentado por visões de um inimigo que pensava morto há muito. 
 
 E assim começa novamente uma história que moldará o destino do mundo inteiro.
 
 * Este jogo é um remake do FINAL FANTASY VII, lançado pela primeira vez em 1997.
 É o primeiro título de uma série dividida em várias partes e é baseado na história do jogo original até à fuga de Midgar, com alguns elementos novos adicionados.

 壮大な物語や魅力的なキャラクター、当時の最先端技術が駆使された映像で多くの人を魅了した不朽の名作が、時を経て「新たな物語」として生まれ変わります。

 ■STORY

 魔晄によって世界を掌握した巨大企業《神羅カンパニー》と星を守るために立ち上がった反神羅組織《アバランチ》が激突する。
 元ソルジャーのクラウドは、傭兵としてアバランチの《壱番魔晄炉爆破作戦》に参加していた。

 花売りの女性が差し出した黄色い花。
 花言葉は――《再会》
 その刹那、ふたりを取り囲む黒い影――《運命の番人》。
 今、想いが再び星を巡る。
 
 ※本作は1997年に発売された『FINAL FANTASY VII』のリメイク作品です。

  About the Game FINAL FANTASY VII REMAKE is a bold reimagining of the original FINAL FANTASY VII, originally released in 1997, developed under the guidance of the original key developers.
 This critically-acclaimed game, which mixes traditional command-based combat and real-time action, makes its Steam debut along with FF7R EPISODE INTERmission─a new story arc featuring Yuffie Kisaragi.
 
    
 
 ■STORY
 
 By exploiting mako, the life-blood of the planet, through their mako reactors, the Shinra Electric Power Company has all but seized control of the entire world. A ragtag group of idealists, known as Avalanche, are one of the last bastions of resistance.
 
 Cloud, an elite SOLDIER operative-turned-mercenary takes part in an Avalanche operation to destroy Mako Reactor 1 in the city of Midgar. 
 The bombing plunges the city into fiery chaos, and Cloud is tormented by visions of a bitter enemy long thought dead. 
 
 Once more begins a story that will shape the destiny of an entire world.
 
 * This game is a remake of FINAL FANTASY VII, first released in 1997.
 The first title in a multi-part series, it is based on the story from the original game, up to the escape from Midgar, adding in new elements.
 
    
 
 ■FF7R EPISODE INTERmission (New episode featuring Yuffie Kisaragi)
 
 FF7R EPISODE INTERmission is a brand-new adventure in the world of FINAL FANTASY VII REMAKE INTERGRADE. Play as Wutaian ninja Yuffie Kisaragi as she infiltrates Midgar and conspires with Avalanche HQ to steal the ultimate materia from the Shinra Electric Power Company.
 
    
 
 ■Content included in this product
 
 FINAL FANTASY VII REMAKE INTERGRADE contains the following content:
 - FINAL FANTASY VII REMAKE full game
 - DLC "FF7R EPISODE INTERmission" (New episode featuring Yuffie Kisaragi)

 *The additional weapons, armor, accessories and summon materia can be obtained from the Gift Box on the main menu.
 *The weapon "Cacstar" can only be used in FF7R EPISODE INTERmission (Yuffie episode)

Final Fantasy VII Remake Intergrade is an enhanced and expanded version of Final Fantasy VII Remake that features a new episode starring Yuffie and introduces an exhilarating new story arc with numerous gameplay additions for players to enjoy.

Try our new game—We, Junk Artists!      
 
 
  Join Us On Discord!  
 
  Perfect Day Studio  
 
  About the Game       
  Insomnia: Theater in the Head（失眠）
  As the name suggests, it is a game depicting the feeling of insomnia, whose plot is revealed through the exquisite hand-drawn paintings of KeKe, the chief artist of "A Perfect Day". 
  
  Hickory dickory dock. The city's deep in sleep. The clock's ticking. The sheep's bouncing. Hickory dickory dock. The girl flips on her left side for the third time in the night, only with more things swarming into her head... Well, the show in the head is rolling on again. Is it possible to get some sleep tonight?
       It's deep in the night. Have you ever been turning and tossing in bed? It's late in the night. Have you been turning and tossing in bed? Are you sad, worried, stressed, anxious, or confused? Did any negative emotions from the day affect your sleep? Or are you simply sleepless?
  
  Anyway, we hope you can enjoy good sleep every day after playing this game!

  关于游戏       
  《失眠》（Insomnia: Theater in the Head）是一款精巧，可爱，情绪满满的短篇点击解谜作品。 
  
  正如其名，这是一款表达对失眠感受的游戏，故事情节由《完美的一天》主美KeKe创作的精美手绘画展开。
       城市入梦，秒针嘀嗒，小小羊儿还在枕边蹦跳。女孩第三次尝试向左翻身，脑袋里却越来越热闹……唉，脑内的演出又要开幕了，今晚还能不能睡得着？
  
  夜深了，你是否曾经有过辗转难眠的经历。你是否有忧愁，有烦恼，有压力，有焦虑，有困惑？或许因为白天的事情而产生的种种负面情绪影响了你的睡眠质量，或许只是单纯的睡不着……
  
  但无论如何，祝愿你在游玩过《失眠》后每天都能睡个好觉！

 夜深了，你是否曾經有過輾轉難眠的經歷。你是否有憂愁，有煩惱，有壓力，有焦慮，有困惑？或許因為白天的事情而產生的種種負面情緒影響了你的睡眠質量，或許只是單純的睡不著……

  Perfect Day Studio  
 
  Acerca del juego      
 
 "Insomnia" es un breve juego de rompecabezas Point & Click elegante, bonito y lleno de delicadas emociones.
 
 Como su nombre indica, es un juego que representa la sensación de insomnio, cuya trama se revela a través de los exquisitos dibujos a mano de KeKe, la artista principal de "A Perfect Day".
      
 La ciudad está sumida en el sueño. El reloj hace tictac. Las ovejas rebotan. La chica se voltea sobre su lado izquierdo por tercera vez en la noche, sólo que con más cosas pululando en su cabeza... Bueno, el espectáculo en la cabeza está rodando de nuevo. ¿Es posible dormir un poco esta noche?
 
 Es una noche profunda. ¿Alguna vez has dado vueltas en la cama? Es tarde en la noche. ¿Has estado dando vueltas y vueltas en la cama? ¿Estás triste, preocupado, estresado, ansioso o confundido? ¿Las emociones negativas del día han afectado a tu sueño? ¿O simplemente estás insomne?
 
 En cualquier caso, ¡esperamos que puedas disfrutar de un buen sueño cada día después de jugar a este juego!

Try our new game—We, Junk Artists!      
 
 
  Join Us On Discord!  
 
  Perfect Day Studio  
 
  À propos du jeu      
 
 «Insomnia» est un jeu point-and-click touchant et captivant.
 
 Comme son nom le suggère, il s’agit d’un jeu qui explore le thème de l’insomnie, et l’histoire te sera contée à l’aide des superbes illustrations faites main de KeKe, le lead artiste derrière «A Perfect Day».
      
 La ville rêve, les minutes s’égrainent, et les moutons défilent. C’est déjà la troisième fois que la petite fille se retourne dans son lit, mais le sommeil ne vient pas... Oh, le spectacle onirique va commencer, va-t-on dormir ce soir ?
 
 La nuit est déjà bien avancée, t’es-t-il déjà arrivé de te retourner dans ton lit sans trouver le sommeil ? T’es-tu senti-e triste, troublé-e, anxieux-se, ou confus-e ? Peut-être que les émotions de la journée ont affecté ton sommeil, ou peut-être que tu n’arrives juste pas à dormir...
 
 Quoiqu’il en soit, je te souhaite de passer d’excellentes nuits chaque jour, quand tu auras finis «Insomnia» !

  Perfect Day Studio  
 
  Infos zum Spiel      
 
 „Insomnia“ ist ein gut detailreiches, niedliches und gefühlsbetontes Puzzle-Spiel mit kurzen Episoden zum Durchspielen.
 
 Wie der Name schon sagt, wird in diesem Spiel ausgedrückt, wie man sich mit Schlaflosigkeit fühlt, und das alles in einer Geschichte, die sich auf wunderschönen handgezeichneten Bildern von KeKe, dem Hauptkünstler von A Perfect Day, abspielt.
      
 Die ganze Stadt träumt und der Sekundenzeiger tickt, doch die Schäfchen hüpfen noch immer neben dem Kissen dieses Mädchens herum. Es dreht sich zum dritten Mal nach links, aber findet keine Ruhe ... Hach, ob ich heute Nacht schlafen kann?
 
 Hattest du schon einmal das Problem, dich spät in der Nacht hin und her zu wälzen? Hast du Kummer, Sorgen, Stress, Ängste und Unsicherheit? Vielleicht wurde die Qualität deines Schlafs durch all die negativen Gefühle, die wegen der Ereignisse während des Tages entstanden sind, beeinträchtigt oder du hast einfach Schwierigkeiten einzuschlafen ...
 
 Was es auch sein mag, wir hoffen, dass du nach dem Spielen von „Insomnia“ einen erholsamen Schlaf genießen kannst!

Try our new game—We, Junk Artists!      
 
 
  Join Us On Discord!  
 
  Perfect Day Studio  
 
  Acerca do jogo      
 
 Insomnia é um jogo bem elaborado de enigmas e cheia de emoções.
 
 Como o próprio nome diz, este é um jogo sobre a sensação da insônia, e a sua história se desenrola com os desenhos feito à mão pela KeKe, chefe artístico de A Perfect Day.
 
 À noite caiu, os ponteiros do relógio fazem tic-tac, e os carneirinhos estão pulando sem parar. Já é a terceira vez que a garotinha vira para o lado esquerdo, mas seus pensamentos continuam muito ativos... Ugh, minha imaginação está a mil, será que vou conseguir dormir hoje?
      
 Você já teve insônia alguma vez durante a noite? Você está com preocupações, ou tem ansiedade e estresse? Ou o seu trabalho durante o dia tem afetado sua qualidade de sono? Ou talvez, simplesmente não consegue adormecer mesmo...
 
 Independentemente do caso, esperamos que você possa ter uma boa noite de sono após jogar "Insomnia"!

Try our new game—We, Junk Artists!      
 
 
  Join Us On Discord!  
 
  Perfect Day Studio  
 
  ゲームについて      
 
 『インソムニア：頭の中の劇場』は、精巧でかわいく、感情豊かな短編ポイント＆クリックパズルADVです。
 
 タイトル通り、本作は眠れない気持ちを表現したゲームであり、『A Perfect Day』（『完璧な一日』）のメインアーティストであるKeKeが描く美しい手描き絵でストーリーが展開されるのが特徴です。
      
 街は眠り、秒針はチクタクと進み、羊は枕元で柵を飛んでいる。彼女は眠れないまま3度目の寝返りをうち、頭の中は騒がしくなる一方…はあ、頭の中でショーがまた開かれようとしている…今夜は眠れるのでしょうか？
 
 深夜に眠れないまま寝返りを打ったことはありませんか？心配事、悩み、ストレス、不安、混乱を抱えていませんか？昼間の出来事から生じたネガティブな感情が睡眠に影響しているのか、それとも、単に眠れないだけでしょうか…
 
 いずれにせよ、『インソムニア：頭の中の劇場』をプレイして、良い夢をご堪能ください！

  Perfect Day Studio  
 
  About the Game       
  Insomnia: Theater in the Head（失眠）
  As the name suggests, it is a game depicting the feeling of insomnia, whose plot is revealed through the exquisite hand-drawn paintings of KeKe, the chief artist of "A Perfect Day". 
  
  Hickory dickory dock. The city's deep in sleep. The clock's ticking. The sheep's bouncing. Hickory dickory dock. The girl flips on her left side for the third time in the night, only with more things swarming into her head... Well, the show in the head is rolling on again. Is it possible to get some sleep tonight?
       It's deep in the night. Have you ever been turning and tossing in bed? It's late in the night. Have you been turning and tossing in bed? Are you sad, worried, stressed, anxious, or confused? Did any negative emotions from the day affect your sleep? Or are you simply sleepless?
  
  Anyway, we hope you can enjoy good sleep every day after playing this game!

game.title: Fallen London
game.description:
Fallen London is a browser-based choose-your-own-adventure game set in "Fallen London", an alternative Victorian London with gothic overtones.

Forty years ago, London was stolen by bats.
Discover a dark and hilarious Gothic underworld where Hell is close, immortality is cheap, and the screaming has largely stopped...

Welcome. Delicious friend.

game.title: Moonmist
game.description:
Moonmist is an interactive fiction computer game written by Stu Galley and Jim Lawrence and published by Infocom in 1986. The game was released simultaneously for many platforms, including the IBM PC, Apple II, Amiga, Atari ST and Commodore 64. It is Infocom's twenty-second game.
Galley and Lawrence previously wrote Seastalker for Infocom.

The player's character is a young detective, asked by friend Tamara Lynd to investigate her new home of Tresyllian Castle in Cornwall, England. Tamara has recently become engaged to the castle's lord, Jack Tresyllian. She was very happy until she began seeing what appeared to be The White Lady, a ghost who has allegedly haunted the castle for centuries. As if seeing a ghost wasn't nerve-racking enough, she's also begun to fear for her life. Is Tamara's imagination just overly excited from living in a large old castle, or is someone really trying to kill her? And if her life is in danger, is it from a ghost or someone using it as a disguise?

game.title: Echoes of the End
game.description:
Embark on a perilous journey to rescue your brother and prevent a looming war. Harness the power of devastating magical abilities to conquer enemies, traverse treacherous landscapes, and unveil the hidden history of Aema.

Once united, the world of Aema has long since fallen into chaos. The ever-feuding Descendant Nations wage bloody wars over the ashes of an empire, while beneath the surface, ancient powers stir.
Step into the madness of a world at war as a vestige wielding forgotten magic. Uncover lost histories, confront rising threats, and shape the future of a world trapped in the past.

game.title: Detroit: Become Human
game.description:
Featuring world-renowned actors including Jesse Williams (Grey’s Anatomy), Clancy Brown (Carnivale), Lance Henriksen  (Aliens), Bryan Dechart (True Blood) and Valorie Curry (Twilight). 

WHAT MAKES US HUMAN?    
 
Detroit 2038. Technology has evolved to a point where human like androids are everywhere. They speak, move and behave like human beings, but they are only machines serving humans.

 Play three distinct androids and see a world at the brink of chaos – perhaps our future - through their eyes. Your very decisions will dramatically alter how the game’s intense, branching narrative plays out.
 
 You will face moral dilemmas and decide who lives or dies. With thousands of choices and dozens of possible endings, how will you affect the future of Detroit and humanity’s destiny?
 
     PLAY YOUR PART IN A GRIPPING NARRATIVE 
Enter a world where moral dilemmas and difficult decisions can turn android slaves into world-changing revolutionaries. Discover what it means to be human from the perspective of an outsider – and see the world through the eyes of a machine. 

THEIR LIVES, YOUR CHOICES  
Shape an ambitious branching narrative, where your decisions not only determine the fate of the three main characters, but that of the entire city of Detroit. How you control Kara, Connor and Markus can mean life or death – and if one of them pays the ultimate price, the story still continues… 

COUNTLESS PATHS, COUNTLESS ENDINGS  Every decision you make, no matter how minute, affects the outcome of the story. No playthrough will be exactly the same: replay again and again to discover a totally different conclusion. 

FULLY OPTIMIZED FOR PC  
Detroit: Become Human is brought to PC with stunning graphics, 4K resolution, 60 fps framerate and full integration of both mouse/keyboard and gamepad controls for the most complete Detroit: Become Human experience to date.

localized_description.text:
Featuring world-renowned actors including Jesse Williams (Grey’s Anatomy), Clancy Brown (Carnivale), Lance Henriksen  (Aliens), Bryan Dechart (True Blood) and Valorie Curry (Twilight). 

WHAT MAKES US HUMAN?    
 
Detroit 2038. Technology has evolved to a point where human like androids are everywhere. They speak, move and behave like human beings, but they are only machines serving humans.

 Play three distinct androids and see a world at the brink of chaos – perhaps our future - through their eyes. Your very decisions will dramatically alter how the game’s intense, branching narrative plays out.
 
 You will face moral dilemmas and decide who lives or dies. With thousands of choices and dozens of possible endings, how will you affect the future of Detroit and humanity’s destiny?
 
     PLAY YOUR PART IN A GRIPPING NARRATIVE 
Enter a world where moral dilemmas and difficult decisions can turn android slaves into world-changing revolutionaries. Discover what it means to be human from the perspective of an outsider – and see the world through the eyes of a machine. 

THEIR LIVES, YOUR CHOICES  
Shape an ambitious branching narrative, where your decisions not only determine the fate of the three main characters, but that of the entire city of Detroit. How you control Kara, Connor and Markus can mean life or death – and if one of them pays the ultimate price, the story still continues… 

COUNTLESS PATHS, COUNTLESS ENDINGS  Every decision you make, no matter how minute, affects the outcome of the story. No playthrough will be exactly the same: replay again and again to discover a totally different conclusion. 

FULLY OPTIMIZED FOR PC  
Detroit: Become Human is brought to PC with stunning graphics, 4K resolution, 60 fps framerate and full integration of both mouse/keyboard and gamepad controls for the most complete Detroit: Become Human experience to date.

Detroit, 2038. La tecnología ha evolucionado hasta tal punto que hay androides de apariencia humana en todas partes. Hablan, se mueven y se comportan como seres humanos, pero no son más que máquinas al servicio de los humanos.

 Maneja a tres androides distintos y contempla un mundo al borde del caos (¿quizás nuestro futuro?) a través de sus ojos. Tus decisiones afectarán drásticamente a la intensa trama ramificada del juego.

 Te enfrentarás a dilemas morales y decidirás quién vive y quién muere. Con miles de decisiones y docenas de posibles finales, ¿cómo afectarás al futuro de Detroit y el destino de la humanidad?

     OCUPA TU LUGAR EN UNA HISTORIA CAUTIVADORA 
Adéntrate en un mundo donde dilemas morales y difíciles decisiones pueden convertir a los esclavos androides en revolucionarios que cambiarán el mundo. Descubre lo que significa ser humano desde una perspectiva ajena y contempla el mundo con los ojos de una máquina. 

SUS VIDAS, TUS DECISIONES  
Guía las ramificaciones de una historia ambiciosa en la que tus decisiones no solo determinarán el destino de los tres protagonistas, sino de toda la ciudad de Detroit. La forma en que controlas a Kara, Connor y Markus puede suponer su vida o su muerte; y si uno de ellos paga el precio final, la historia continuará...

 CAMINOS INCONTABLES, INCONTABLES FINALES  
Cada decisión que tomes, por ínfima que parezca, afecta al resultado de la historia. Ninguna partida será exactamente igual: repite el juego una y otra vez para descubrir diferentes conclusiones. 

TOTALMENTE OPTIMIZADO PARA PC  
Detroit: Become Human llega a PC con impresionantes gráficos, resolución en 4K, una tasa de fotogramas de 60 FPS e integración completa tanto con ratón y teclado como con mandos, para hacer de esta la experiencia de Detroit: Become Human más completa hasta la fecha.

QU'EST-CE QUI NOUS REND HUMAIN ?    

 Détroit, 2038. L'évolution de la technologie a créé un monde où les robots androïdes sont partout. Ils parlent, se déplacent et se comportent comme des humains, mais ce ne sont que des machines au service de ces derniers.

 À travers les yeux de trois androïdes, découvrez un monde au bord du chaos. Prenez des décisions, tout en sachant qu'elles auront un immense impact sur l'incroyable histoire du jeu et ses différentes intrigues.

 Vous serez confronté à des dilemmes et devrez décider qui va vivre... et qui doit mourir. Avec des milliers de choix et des dizaines de fins différentes, quelle influence allez-vous avoir sur le futur de Détroit et le destin de l'humanité ?

     JOUEZ UN RÔLE DANS UNE INTRIGUE SURPRENANTE 
Entrez dans un monde où les dilemmes moraux et les décisions difficiles peuvent transformer des esclaves androïdes en révolutionnaires. Découvrez ce qui vous rend humain, du point de vue de quelqu'un qui ne l'est pas. Voyez le monde à travers les yeux d'un robot. 

VOS CHOIX, LEURS DESTINS  
Découvrez une intrigue fascinante, dans laquelle vos décisions déterminent non seulement le destin des trois personnages principaux, mais également celui de la ville de Détroit tout entière. La vie de Kara, Connor et Markus dépend de la façon dont vous les contrôlez, et si l'un d'entre eux périt... l'histoire continue. 

DES CHOIX ET DES FINS À L'INFINI  
Chaque décision, même la plus infime, affecte le déroulement de l'histoire. Chaque partie est différente : vous pouvez rejouer encore et encore pour découvrir d'autres possibilités. 

OPTIMISÉ POUR PC 
 Detroit: Become Human arrive maintenant sur PC avec des graphismes incroyables, une résolution 4K, un débit 60 FPS et une intégration complète des commandes souris/clavier ou gamepad, pour vous offrir l'expérience de jeu la plus complète à ce jour.

WAS MACHT UNS ZU MENSCHEN?    

 Detroit 2038. Die Technologie hat sich so weit entwickelt, dass menschenähnliche Androiden überall zu finden sind. Sie sprechen, bewegen und verhalten sich wie Menschen, aber sie sind nur Maschinen, die dem Menschen dienen.

 Spielen Sie als drei verschiedene Androiden und sehen Sie durch ihre Augen eine Welt am Rande des Chaos, die vielleicht unsere Zukunft sein könnte. Ihre gezielten Entscheidungen werden den Ablauf der intensiven, verzweigten Story des Spiels drastisch verändern.

 Sie stehen vor einem moralischen Dilemma und entscheiden, wer lebt oder stirbt. Wie werden Sie bei Tausenden von Wahlmöglichkeiten und Dutzenden möglicher Enden die Zukunft Detroits und das Schicksal der Menschheit beeinflussen?

     SPIELEN SIE IHREN TEIL IN EINER PACKENDEN STORY 
Betreten Sie in eine Welt, in der moralische Dilemmata und schwierige Entscheidungen androide Sklaven in weltbewegende Revolutionäre verwandeln können. Entdecken Sie aus der Perspektive eines Außenstehenden, was es bedeutet, ein Mensch zu sein – und sehen Sie die Welt mit den Augen einer Maschine.

 IHR LEBEN, IHRE WAHL  
Gestalten Sie eine ambitionierte und verwobene Story, in der Ihre Entscheidungen nicht nur das Schicksal der drei Hauptfiguren, sondern das der gesamten Stadt Detroit bestimmen. Wie Sie Kara, Connor und Markus kontrollieren, kann Leben oder Tod bedeuten – und wenn einer der Charaktere stirbt, geht die Geschichte trotzdem weiter ... 

UNZÄHLIGE WEGE, ZAHLLOSE ENDEN  
Jede Entscheidung, die Sie treffen, wie klein sie auch sein mag, beeinflusst das Ende der Geschichte. Kein Durchspielen gleicht dem anderen: Spielen Sie immer und immer wieder, um ein völlig anderes Ende zu erleben. 

VOLLSTÄNDIG OPTIMIERT FÜR PC  
Detroit: Become Human erscheint auf dem PC mit atemberaubender Grafik, 4K-Auflösung, 60 fps Framerate und voller Integration für Maus/Tastatur und Gamepad für das bis dato vollständigste Erlebnis von Detroit: Become Human.

QUE É QUE NOS TORNA HUMANOS?    

 Detroit 2038. A tecnologia evoluiu até um ponto onde há androides idênticos a humanos por toda a parte. Eles falam, movem-se e comportam-se como seres humanos, mas são apenas máquinas ao serviço deles.

 Joga como três androides diferentes e vê um mundo à beira do caos - quiçá alusivo ao nosso futuro - através da sua perspetiva. As tuas decisões vão alterar significativamente o desenrolar da intensa narrativa ramificada do jogo.

 Vais enfrentar dilemas morais e decidir quem vive ou morre. Com milhares de escolhas e dezenas de finais possíveis, como é que irás afetar o futuro de Detroit e o destino da humanidade?

     DESEMPENHA O TEU PAPEL NUMA NARRATIVA EMOCIONANTE
 Entra num mundo onde dilemas morais e decisões difíceis podem transformar escravos androides em revolucionários que podem mudar o mundo. Descobre o que significa ser humano da perspetiva de um estranho - e vê o mundo através dos olhos de uma máquina. 

AS SUAS VIDAS, AS TUAS ESCOLHAS  
Dá forma a uma narrativa ramificada ambiciosa, onde as tuas decisões não só determinam o destino dos três personagens principais, mas também o de toda a cidade de Detroit. Como controlas a Kara, o Connor e o Markus pode levar à vida ou à morte - e se um deles pagar o derradeiro preço, a história continua... 

INÚMEROS CAMINHOS, INÚMEROS FINAIS
  Todas as decisões que tomas, não importa o quão minúsculas, afetam o desenrolar da narrativa. Nenhum jogo será exatamente igual: joga várias vezes para descobrir uma conclusão totalmente diferente. 

COMPLETAMENTE OTIMIZADO PARA PC  
Detroit: Become Human chega aos PCs com gráficos deslumbrantes, resolução 4K de 60 fotogramas por segundo e integração completa de controlos de rato/teclado ou comando para a experiência mais completa de sempre de Detroit: Become Human.

VAD GØR OS TIL MENNESKER?    

 Detroit 2038. Teknologien har udviklet sig til et punkt, hvor menneskelignende androider er overalt. De taler, bevæger og opfører sig som mennesker, men de er kun maskiner, der tjener mennesker.

 Spil som tre forskellige androider, og oplev en verden på randen af kaos - måske vores fremtid - gennem deres øjne. Dine beslutninger vil på dramatisk vis ændre, hvordan spillets intense, komplekse fortælling udfolder sig.

 Du kommer til at stå over for moralske dilemmaer og skal beslutte, hvem der lever eller dør. Hvordan vil du påvirke Detroits fremtid og menneskehedens skæbne, når du bliver stillet overfor tusindvis af valg og snesevis af mulige slutninger?

     SPIL DIN ROLLE I EN MEDRIVENDE FORTÆLLING 
Træd ind i en verden, hvor moralske dilemmaer og vanskelige beslutninger kan gøre androide-slaver til revolutionære, der ændrer verden. Oplev, hvad det betyder at være menneske fra en udenforståendes perspektiv - og se verden gennem en maskines øjne. 

DERES LIV, DINE VALG 
 Skab en ambitiøs, kompleks fortælling, hvor dine beslutninger ikke kun bestemmer de tre hovedpersoners skæbne, men også hele Detroits skæbne. Hvordan du styrer Kara, Connor og Markus kan betyde liv eller død - og hvis en af dem betaler den ultimative pris, fortsætter historien stadig… 

UTALLIGE MULIGHEDER, UTALLIGE SLUTNINGER 
 Hver beslutning, du træffer, uanset hvor ubetydelig den er, påvirker resultatet af historien. Intet spil er nøjagtigt det samme: spil igen og igen for at opdage en helt anden konklusion.

 FULDT OPTIMERET TIL PC  
Detroit: Become Human fås til pc med enestående grafik, 4K-opløsning, billedhastighed på 60 fps og fuld integration af både mus/tastatur- og gamepad-kontroller for den mest komplette Detroit: Become Human-oplevelse til dato.

S'È CHE CI RENDE UMANI?    

 Detroit, 2038. La tecnologia si è evoluta a tal punto che gli androidi umanoidi sono ovunque. Parlano, si muovono e si comportano come persone, ma sono solo macchine al servizio degli esseri umani.

 Controlla tre diversi androidi e osserva coi loro occhi un mondo a un passo dal caos... forse, il nostro stesso futuro. Saranno le tue decisioni ad alterare il corso degli eventi e a governare la storia attraverso le complesse ramificazioni della trama.

 Affronterai dilemmi morali e stabilirai chi vive e chi muore. Con migliaia di scelte e decine di finali possibili, come influirai sul futuro di Detroit e il destino dell'umanità?

     PRENDI PARTE A UNA STORIA COINVOLGENTE 
Entra in un universo in cui dilemmi morali e decisioni difficili possono trasformare degli schiavi androidi in rivoluzionari destinati a cambiare il mondo. Scopri cosa significa essere umani da una prospettiva esterna e guarda il mondo attraverso gli occhi di una macchina. 

LE LORO VITE, LE TUE SCELTE  
Fatti strada attraverso un'ambiziosa struttura narrativa ramificata, in cui le tue decisioni non determinano solo il fato dei tre protagonisti, ma di tutta la città di Detroit. Il modo in cui controllerai Kara, Connor e Markus farà la differenza tra la vita e la morte. E se uno di loro la pagherà a caro prezzo, la storia andrà comunque avanti... 

INFINITE POSSIBILITÀ, INFINITI FINALI  
Ogni scelta che fai, per quanto piccola, influenza l'esito della storia. Nessuna partita sarà esattamente uguale a un'altra: gioca più e più volte per arrivare a conclusioni totalmente differenti. 

OTTIMIZZATO PER PC
  Detroit: Become Human ha una straordinaria grafica con risoluzione in 4K, frame rate di 60 FPS e integrazione completa di mouse/tastiera e gamepad per immergersi totalmente nell'esperienza di Detroit: Become Human.

在Quantic Dream开发的《底特律：化身为人》中，本作延续开发团队的传统，为您带来憾人心弦、身历其境的故事体验。您将在一个由选择和后果所组成的壮烈的感性旅程中发现身为人的真正意义。

在2038年的底特律市，这座城市因发明并将仿生人带入日常生活中而欣欣向荣。 但是当仿生人开始表现得像是真的具有生命的时候，事情开始失控。 进入故事的三个关键角色卡菈、康纳和马库斯的角色，他们每个人都会从各自的独特观点，面对新的生活挑战。

在这个野心勃勃、令人激动的故事中，每一个选择和行动不仅决定了各个角色的命运，还决定了整个城市的去向，以及更长远的影响。

《往左一点》是一款整理类益智游戏，玩家要对家居物品进行分类、叠放和排列，使它们各居其位，但要注意里面有只淘气猫咪喜欢捣乱！
  
  
 
   谜题隐藏在家居用品中
   谜题的设计既直观又惬意，解决方法也多种多样
   “每日整理投递”每天都会给你送去一道独一无二的谜题
   游戏非常适合休闲益智游戏迷，以及能够从井井有条的空间中获得满足感的人
   随心所欲地通过“随它”选项跳过关卡，然后选择何时再来处理某些混乱谜题
   需要提示？少许还是大量？借助独一无二的提示系统，你可以控制每一关中解决方案的透露程度。  
  
 
 时钟的指针应该指向哪个方向？鸡蛋要如何排列？是谁在水果上贴了这么多贴纸？！？
 加入游戏即可畅享一个宁静的世界，每个角落都有令人惊喜、考验观察力的益智游戏。
 《往左一点》中处处是迷人的插图和惊艳的场景，超过100个赏心悦目的谜题等你来发现，让好奇心得到彻底的满足。不过要留意那只喜欢把东西弄乱的淘气猫喔！
  
  
 
 在“每日整理”模式中，你每天都会收到一道谜题，是根据我们最喜爱的谜题专为你改编而成。
 每天找出所有解决方法就能赢得有趣的徽章！要是在现实生活中进行整理也有这样的奖励就好啦。
  
  
 
 想在七月里享受节日的快乐？抑或是在五月里感受到恐怖？
 《向左一点》现已推出谜题档案，能够回味此前的限时应季关卡。现在无论是几月，都能畅玩关于圣诞节、复活节、万圣节等各项主题的混乱谜题。 特色：   100多个独特的逻辑谜题
   能够快速解决的谜题，带来满意的游戏体验
   直观的拖放控制方式
   “每日整理投递”每天都会给你送去一道独一无二的谜题
   解决方法多种多样
   插图充满魅力
   氛围感十足的配乐
   淘气（但十分可爱）的猫咪
   搞笑又好玩，完美适合所有年龄段！

「《靠左一些些》(A Little to the Left) 是一個有條有理的益智遊戲，請玩家將家中的各種物品分類、堆疊、整理得恰到好處，還有一隻調皮的貓，喜歡出其不意地搞破壞！
  
  
 
   謎題就暗藏在家中的物品裡
   多種解法，設計上符合直觀且又療癒
   「每日宅配整理任務」(The Daily Tidy Delivery) 每天為您特別出一個謎題
   格外適合偏好輕鬆解謎遊戲的玩家，和置身於有條不紊的空間會感到十分舒暢的人士
   可按照您的意思使用「隨它去」選項跳過關卡，自己決定何時想要挑戰某些混亂場面
   需要提示？那您想要一點點，還是很多呢？本遊戲採取獨特的提示系統，由您自行掌控每一關透露多大程度的解方。   
  
 
 時鐘的指針應該朝哪個方向？雞蛋該如何排列？是誰在水果上黏這麼多貼紙？！
 快進入這個令人賞心悅目的益智遊戲，享受使人平靜，又小巧思無所不在的驚奇世界。
 《靠左一些些》有特别精美的插圖和別出心裁的情境，不僅帶來滿足感，還有超過 100 種好玩的謎題待您發現。對了，請留意一隻頑皮的貓咪，牠特別喜歡搗蛋！
  
  
 
 「每日整理」模式中每天會為您出一道題，是我們從最愛的謎題精選，經過特別為您更動而成。
 每天找到全部解答，可贏得趣味徽章！要是現實生活之中整理家務有這麼高的回報，該有多好。
  
  
 
 想要享受七月的應景歡樂嗎？到了五月，格外覺得膽戰心驚嗎？
 《靠左一些些》即日起設置了歷史謎題庫，讓玩家能夠永久性地取用原先限時的季節性關卡。今起您可享受環繞聖誕節、復活節、萬聖節等等節日的凌亂環境，不分當時的月份。 特色：   超過 100 種獨特的邏輯性謎題
   能快速解出的謎題，玩起來充滿成就感
   直觀性的拖放控制方式
   「每日宅配整理任務」每天為您送上獨一無二的任務
   多種解方
   畫面美感十足
   氣氛濃厚的配樂
   調皮（但非常可愛）的貓咪
   有趣又好玩，老少咸宜！

Sort, stack, and organize household objects into just the right spot in A Little to the Left, a tidy puzzle game with a mischievous cat who likes to shake things up!
  
  
 
   Puzzles hidden among household objects
   Multiple solutions make for intuitive and satisfying puzzle design
   A puzzle unique for you every day with The Daily Tidy Delivery
   Perfect for casual puzzle game fans and those who get a jolt of satisfaction from a well organized space
   Feel free to skip levels with the "Let It Be" option, and choose when you want to tackle certain messes
   Need a hint? A little or a lot? With a unique hint system, you control how much of the solution is revealed in each level.  
  
  
 Which way should the clock hands point? How to arrange the eggs? Who put so many stickers on this fruit?!?
 Come enjoy a calming world in an observational puzzle game with surprises around every corner.
 Featuring charming illustrations and surprising scenarios, A Little to the Left is satisfying and curious with over 100 delightful puzzles to discover. Keep your eye out for a mischievous cat who has an inclination for chaos!
  
  
 
 In the Daily Tidy mode, you’ll get a puzzle delivered EVERY DAY with variations on our favorite puzzles that’s unique to you.
 Find all the solutions each day to earn fun badges! If only tidying in real life was this rewarding.

Triez, empilez et organisez des objets du quotidien pour les placer au bon endroit. A Little to the Left est un jeu mêlant réflexion et rangement, où un chat espiègle prend un malin plaisir à mettre le bazar !
  
  
 
   Des casse-tête cachés parmi les objets du quotidien.
   Plusieurs solutions possibles pour une conception de casse-tête intuitive et satisfaisante.
   Un casse-tête personnalisé chaque jour avec l'Opération Rangement quotidien.
   Idéal pour les fans de jeux de réflexion occasionnels qui apprécient les espaces bien organisés.
   N'hésitez pas à passer des niveaux avec l'option « Lâcher l'affaire » et choisissez quand vous voudrez remettre un peu d'ordre dans tout ce souk.
   Besoin d'un indice ? Un peu ? Beaucoup ? Le système d'indices unique vous permet de contrôler la part de solution révélée dans chaque niveau.   
  
 
 Quelle heure les aiguilles de l'horloge doivent-elles indiquer ? Comment ranger les œufs ? Qui a collé toutes ces étiquettes sur ce fruit ?!?
 Venez découvrir un monde apaisant et bourré de surprises qu'offre ce jeu de réflexion et d'observation.
 Avec des illustrations charmantes et des scénarios surprenants, plus de 100 casse-tête exquis mettent au défi votre curiosité dans A Little to the Left. Gardez un œil sur un chat espiègle ayant un penchant pour le chaos !
 
  
  
 Dans le mode Rangement quotidien, nous vous proposons un casse-tête personnalisé CHAQUE JOUR avec des variations sur nos casse-tête préférés.
 Trouvez toutes les solutions chaque jour pour gagner des badges rigolos. Si seulement le ménage était aussi gratifiant dans la vraie vie !
  
  
 
 Envie de revivre l'ambiance des fêtes de fin d'année en juillet ? De vous faire une petite frayeur en mai ?
 A Little to the Left propose désormais un archivage de casse-tête, qui vous permet d'accéder en permanence aux niveaux saisonniers qui étaient auparavant limités dans le temps. Profitez désormais de la pagaille sur le thème de Noël, de Pâques, d'Halloween et plus encore, à tout moment dans l'année. CARACTÉRISTIQUES :   Plus de 100 casse-tête logiques uniques
   Des casse-tête rapides à résoudre pour un gameplay gratifiant
   Commandes intuitives de type glisser-déposer
   Un casse-tête personnalisé vous est proposé chaque jour avec l'Opération Rangement quotidien
   Plusieurs solutions
   Des illustrations charmantes
   Une conception sonore pleine de poésie
   Un chat espiègle (mais très mignon)
   Amusant et ludique, idéal pour les joueurs de 7 à 77 ans !

Sortiere, staple und organisiere Haushaltsgegenstände bei A Little to the Left, einem ordnungswütigen Puzzlespiel samt schlitzohriger Katze, die gerne Unfug macht!
 
  
 
   Puzzles verstecken sich unter Haushaltsgegenständen.
   Mehrere Lösungen sorgen für intuitive und spaßige Puzzles.
   "Das tägliche Aufräum-Abenteuer" liefert dir jeden Tag ein einzigartiges Puzzle.
   Perfekt für Gelegenheits-Puzzlefreunde und alle, denen ein gut organisierter Raum Freude bringt.
   Überspringe jederzeit Level, indem du "Let It Be" auswählst und selbst bestimmst, wann du welche Unordnung angehen möchtest.
   Brauchst du Hilfe? Etwas oder ganz viel? Durch ein einzigartiges System, wie Hinweise angezeigt werden, kannst du selbst kontrollieren, wieviel in jedem Level von der Lösung preisgegeben wird.  
  
 
 Wohin sollen die Uhrzeiger zeigen? Wie soll man die Eier anordnen? Wer hat so viele Aufkleber auf das Obst gepappt?!?
 Genieße eine beruhigende Welt mit einem Puzzlespiel für aufmerksame Beobachter, das hinter jeder Ecke Überraschungen versteckt.
 Mit bezaubernden Illustrationen und überraschenden Szenarien ist A Little to the Left ein befriedigendes Spiel für Neugierige mit über 100 entzückenden Puzzles, die es zu entdecken gilt. Achte auf die schlitzohrige Katze, die ein Pfötchen fürs Chaos hat!
 
  
 
 Im täglichen Aufräum-Abenteuer bekommst du JEDEN TAG ein Puzzle mit einer Variation eines unserer Lieblingspuzzles, das einzigartig für dich ist.
 Finde jeden Tag alle Lösungen und erhalte lustige Abzeichen! Wenn nur das Aufräumen im echten Leben so lohnend wäre.
  
  
 
 Möchtest du auch im Juli Weihnachtsstimmung aufkommen lassen? Oder hast du bereits im Mai Lust auf Halloween?
 In A Little to the Left gibt es jetzt ein Puzzlearchiv, mit dem du Zugriff auf die vorher zeitbegrenzten, saisonalen Levels hast. Ab jetzt kannst du dich auch am Chaos während der Weihnachtszeit, Ostern, Halloween und mehr erfreuen, egal welcher Monat gerade ist. FEATURES:   Über 100 einzigartige und logische Puzzles
   Schnell zu lösende Puzzles sorgen für ein zufriedenstellendes Spielerlebnis
   Intuitive Drag-and-Drop-Steuerung
   "Das tägliche Aufräum-Abenteuer" liefert dir jeden Tag ein für dich einzigartiges Puzzle
   Verschiedene Lösungswege
   Charmante Illustrationen
   Atmosphärisches Sounddesign
   Eine schlitzohrige (aber sehr niedliche) Katze
   Lustig und spannend, für jede Altersstufe geeignet!

Classifica, empilha e organiza objetos domésticos no sítio certo em A Little to the Left, um metódico jogo de arrumação com um gato maquiavélico que não vai deixar que te aborreças!
  
  
 
   Puzzles escondidos entre os objetos domésticos.
   Design de puzzles seja intuitivo e satisfatório com múltiplas maneiras de resolver os puzzles.
   Todos os dias há um puzzle único para ti com as Entregas Arrumadas Diárias (The Daily Tidy Delivery).
   Perfeito para jogadores ocasionais de jogos de puzzles e para aqueles que adoram ver espaços bem organizados.
   Salta níveis à vontade com a opção "Deixar Estar" e escolhe quando queres tratar de determinadas desarrumações
   Precisas de alguma dica? Precisas de muitas? Com um sistema único de dicas, és tu que controlas quanto da solução é revelada em cada nível.   
  
 
 Para que lado devem apontar os ponteiros do relógio? Como organizo os ovos? Quem colocou tantos autocolantes nesta peça de fruta?!?
 Vem desfrutar de um mundo relaxante com puzzles visuais, cheios de surpresas em cada esquina.
 Com ilustrações encantadoras e cenários surpreendentes, A Little to the Left resulta numa experiência curiosa e gratificante com mais de 100 agradáveis puzzles para descobrir. Fica atento ao gato maquiavélico com um gostinho para o caos!
  
  
 
 Nas Entregas Arrumadas, irás receber um puzzle TODOS OS DIAS, com variações dos nossos puzzles preferidos que seja único para ti.
 Encontra todas as soluções a cada dia para ganhar crachás divertidos! Se ao menos as arrumações fossem assim divertidas na vida real
  
  
 
 Queres um pouco de alegria em julho? Sentes-te um farrapo em maio?
 A Little to the Left tem agora um arquivo de puzzles que te dá acesso permanente a níveis sazonais, que eram previamente de tempo limitado. Podes agora desfrutar de desarrumações na altura do Natal, Páscoa, Halloween e muito mais! CARACTERÍSTICAS:   Mais de 100 puzzles de lógica únicos
   Puzzles fáceis de resolver para teres uma experiência satisfatória
   Controlos intuitivos para arrastar e soltar
   Um puzzle único todos os dias com as Entregas Arrumadas Diárias
   Várias soluções
   Ilustrações encantadoras
   Design de som envolvente
   Um gato maquiavélico, mas extremamente fofo
   Um jogo divertido, apropriado para todas as idades!

『A Little to the Left』は、飼い猫にちょっかいを出されながら、家のものを並べたり、積み上げたりして、ちょうどいい場所に整理整頓していくパズルゲームです。
  
  
 
   家のものの中に色々なパズルが隠れている。
   解決する方法は一つだけじゃない！ だからカンを頼りに、とても楽しくパズルを解くことができる。
   「デイリー・タイディー・デリバリー」で、毎日ユニークなパズルを楽しもう！
   お手軽なパズルゲームを楽しみたい人、整理整頓が大好きな人にうってつけ！
   「レット・イット・ビー」オプションでレベルのスキップが可能。どこを整頓したいか選択ができる！
   ユニークなヒントシステムで、各レベルのヒントの量をコントロール！  
  
 
 時計の針はどちらを指す？ 卵はどう並べよう？ フルーツにこんなにたくさんのシールを貼ったのは誰！？
 心落ち着く世界を堪能しながら、サプライズ満載の観察系パズルゲームを楽しみましょう。
 可愛らしいイラスト、予想を裏切るシナリオ、100個以上の楽しいパズルは大満足間違いなし。そうそう、いらずら好きな飼い猫のちょっかいには気をつけて！
  
  
 
 「デイリー・タイディー・デリバリー」モードは、毎日ユニークなパズルが配信されるシステム。
 楽しみながらバッジをゲットしちゃいましょう。ああ、本物の片付けもこれくらい楽しかったら...！
  
  
 
 7月にクリスマスを堪能したり、5月にハロウィンを楽しみたい時ってありますよね！
 追加された『A Little to the Left』のパズルアーカイブで、これまで期間限定だったシーズンレベルにいつでもアクセスが可能に。クリスマス、イースター、ハロウィンなどなど、季節に関係なくパズルを楽しんじゃいましょう！ 特徴：   100個以上のロジックパズル
   お手軽に進められるシンプルなゲーム
   直感的なドラッグ＆ドロップコントロール
   「デイリー・タイディー・デリバリー」で毎日ユニークなパズルをお届け
   解決方法は一つ以上
   キュートなイラスト
   素敵なサウンドデザイン
   いたずら好き（でもそこが可愛い！）猫
   年齢を問わずに楽しめる！
